handoff: Approve: O2a rerun-at-failed-check and run view check_retry do what gh-213 asks; B50 kept; tests green. Two minor findings (run view observes on every call; code_changed:null branch and markdown line untested).

findings.title: run view now runs a local observe on every call without a run id
findings.detail:
`localUnit` calls `observeLocal(ctx)` (a full observe of the checkout, git and process probes included) every time `run view <unit>` is called without a run id, even when the unit is nowhere near a failed check. A supervisor that polls `run view` pays that cost each time. An observe error would also now fail a command that used to read only the trace.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Only observe when the trace's last state shows a check fail as last_outcome, or catch observe errors and return check_retry: null.

findings.title: code_changed: null and the markdown line are untested
findings.detail:
The integration test covers false → true (dirty) → true (committed) → false and the null check_retry after $done. It never reaches `code_changed: null` (no worktree, or no boundary commit within LOG_LIMIT), and it never checks the markdown line that `run view` adds without --json. The fsd-round skill tells the supervisor to leave the unit alone on null, so that branch matters.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add a unit test of `checkRetry` with a fake GitPort whose log has no boundary commit (expect null), and one assertion on the markdown text.
